incidents.summary: Harbour Energy subsidiary Chrysaor was fined £150,000 after its Armada platform exceeded its 2022 greenhouse-gas venting consent by 145.566 tonnes.

sources.title: Harbour hit with £150K fine for North Sea venting pollution
sources.quote: Energy industry regulator, the North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) has hit Harbour Energy with a £150,000 fine for a breach of greenhouse gas emission limits in the North Sea in 2022.

sources.title: Harbour hit with £150K fine for North Sea venting pollution
sources.quote: In total, the asset vented 370.046 tonnes from 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2022, exceeding its consent by 145.566 tonnes, almost 65%.

sources.title: Harbour hit with £150K fine for North Sea venting pollution
sources.quote: Chrysaor did bring the breach to the NSTA’s attention, fully co-operated with the investigation, had no previous sanctions and has taken steps to prevent future vent consent exceedances

positives: Harbour Energy became a signatory to the World Bank’s Zero Routine Flaring by 2030 initiative.

incidents.summary: Argentina imposed a 15-year operating disqualification on Premier Oil, now Harbour Energy, for exploring near the Falkland Islands/Malvinas without Argentine authorization.

sources.title: Denuncian que una petrolera que opera en Malvinas fue beneficiada con el RIGI
sources.quote: Harbour Energy plc es la misma persona jurídica que anteriormente operaba bajo el nombre de Premier Oil PLC (inscripta bajo el número de sociedad SC234781)

sources.title: Denuncian que una petrolera que opera en Malvinas fue beneficiada con el RIGI
sources.quote: el Estado argentino sancionó a Premier Oil PLC con una inhabilitación por el término de 15 años por desarrollar tareas de exploración en la plataforma continental cerca de Malvinas sin permiso oficial.

sources.title: Denuncian que una petrolera que opera en Malvinas fue beneficiada con el RIGI
sources.quote: Dicha sanción se encuentra vigente hasta 2028.
